summary: Frontend-only test of bug fixes Z1 (control-lievito-madre wording) and Z2 (focaccia revision notice + status badges). Tested public site as anonymous user in IT, DE and EN across PANE (Anima Integrale), FOCACCIA (Focaccia a Lievito Madre, Focaccia Barese) and PIZZA (Pala Pizza). All 5 acceptance criteria verified successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: RecipeExtrasPanel.jsx uses grandeLievitato regex on recipe.name only in one locale; for renamed/localized names this may need to also check menu_category (already does) — currently OK because panettoni are hidden_public.
Console shows repeated 404/401 on some resource fetches on home load — not user-visible but noisy; investigate stray fetches.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Recipe detail dialog opens via [data-testid=home-btn-all] -> [data-testid=recipe-search] -> [data-testid^=recipe-row-]. Key testids on the dialog: recipe-status-badge, focaccia-revision-notice, control-lm. Language switch: click [data-testid=header-lang-btn] then [data-testid=header-lang-it|de|en]. Panettoni are hidden_public — grandeLievitato branch cannot be verified publicly.
